_disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMONSTRATION DATA. Fictional, procedurally generated for the BAYOU-NOVA proof of concept (2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge). Not real crew data. Not a medical record. Not for clinical use.
uncertainty_statement: No field here measures bone density or immune function. Values are indicators with uncertainty; language in the UI must use 'may be consistent with', never 'you have'.

resting_hr_bpm.label: Resting heart rate
resting_hr_bpm.notes: Wearable-derived resting value; not a clinical ECG.

steps.label: Daily steps (preflight only)
steps.notes: Not meaningful in microgravity; null in flight.

exercise_minutes.label: Exercise minutes (in flight)
exercise_minutes.notes: Logged resistance/aerobic session time; null preflight.

concentration_index.label: Concentration index
concentration_index.notes: Derived from check-in answers; see checkin-questions.json.

mood_index.label: Mood index
mood_index.notes: Derived from check-in answers. Not PHQ-9.

vo2max_ml_kg_min.label: VO2 max
vo2max_ml_kg_min.measurement_type: direct measurement (preflight lab) / functional indicator (in-flight estimate)
vo2max_ml_kg_min.notes: In-flight values are submaximal estimates with wider uncertainty.
